data.situation: Later that month, Sam needed help reading a vaccination record he had brought from home. His college had asked him for information, but one entry on the paper was difficult to read. At the clinic’s records window, he unfolded the sheet on a narrow ledge. The date was clear; the vaccine name was not. He pointed to that entry and asked which vaccine it referred to. The staff member checked the old information rather than filling the gap with a guess. Sam waited with his finger beside the line so they were discussing the same entry. Once the name had been checked, Sam asked for confirmation of the vaccination date. A printed copy came out of the machine to the right of the window. He compared it with his paper before putting both in the document envelope. The new copy recorded what had happened in the past. It did not tell him what he should receive next. If the college needed anything else, Sam would ask what information was missing. For now, the envelope held a clearer record rather than an answer invented from an unreadable word.

glossary.note: 本课名词，指记录所列的制剂；与接种行为vaccination分开，不推导个人接种建议。
glossary.example: Which vaccine does this entry refer to?
glossary.exampleZh: 这条记录指的是哪种疫苗？

glossary.note: 名词，接种行为或过程；本课核对过去记录，不依据日期自行决定再接种。
glossary.example: The date of the vaccination is recorded here.
glossary.exampleZh: 疫苗接种日期记在这里。

glossary.note: 表示记载接种信息的记录；record在此是名词，不表示现在给人接种。
glossary.exampleZh: 我带来了疫苗接种记录。

glossary.text: Which … does this entry refer to?
glossary.note: 询问不明确的记录对象；does后主语为this entry，refer to后是所指对象。
glossary.example: Which vaccine does this entry refer to?
glossary.exampleZh: 这条记录指的是哪种疫苗？
matchTexts: Which vaccine does this entry refer to?

glossary.text: Could you confirm the date of …?
glossary.note: 请求核实已有事件日期；不等于询问下一次应该什么时候进行。
glossary.example: Could you confirm the date of this vaccination?
glossary.exampleZh: 您能确认这次疫苗接种的日期吗？
matchTexts: Could you confirm the date of this vaccination?

glossary.text: Could I have a copy of …?
glossary.zh: 我可以拿一份……的副本吗？
glossary.note: 请求文件副本，可用于其他记录；具体服务是否提供由机构回答。
glossary.example: Could I have a copy of this record?
glossary.exampleZh: 我可以拿一份这份记录的副本吗？
matchTexts: Could I have a copy of this record?

retrievalPrompts.cue: A date is clear but the product name is not. Ask which vaccine the entry names.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 日期清楚，但制剂名称看不清。询问记录指哪种疫苗。
acceptableAnswers: Which vaccine does this entry refer to?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Ask about the named product, not a new procedure.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 核对记录对象；不询问新的治疗步骤。
targetTerms: Which … does this entry refer to?

retrievalPrompts.cue: The name has been checked. Ask the staff to confirm the date of that past vaccination.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 名称已核实。请工作人员确认过去这次接种的日期。
acceptableAnswers: Could you confirm the date of this vaccination?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Use vaccination for the event, not vaccine for the date.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 接种事件用vaccination；核对已有日期。
targetTerms: Could you confirm the date of …?

retrievalPrompts.cue: You need a readable version of the record to keep with the original. Request a copy.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你需要一份清楚的记录副本，与原件一起保存。请求副本。
acceptableAnswers: Could I have a copy of this record?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Request a document, not a new vaccination.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 请求文件副本；不是请求新的接种。
targetTerms: Could I have a copy of …?

transferPrompt.cue: At a bank, an unclear entry might name a payment. Ask which payment it refers to and request a copy of the record.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 换到银行：一条不清楚的记录可能写着某笔付款。询问指哪笔付款，并请求副本。
acceptableAnswers: Which payment does this entry refer to? Could I have a copy of this record?
transferPrompt.feedback: Keep the record-checking function and change the domain.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 保留核对记录功能；替换对象和地点。
